sessions.name: scout-mcp-contracts
sessions.task:
Read-only task. In the workspace, recursively find production .ts files under packages/mcp/src that statically import or re-export from '@piwin/contracts' (single or double quotes).

Rules:
- Only .ts files
- Exclude *.test.ts, *.spec.ts
- Exclude any path containing fixtures/
- Count static imports/re-exports matching: from\s+['"]@piwin/contracts['"]
- Do NOT count dynamic import('@piwin/contracts')
- Do NOT count subpaths like '@piwin/contracts/something'
- Each file counts at most once

Return evidence as:
{
  "name": "mcp",
  "count": <number>,
  "files": ["repo-relative/paths sorted lexicographically"],
  "matches": [{"file": "...", "line": <n>, "text": "..."}]
}

Use grep/rg or read-only bash. Do not modify anything.
